name: Nonlinear animation is all you need
description:
Make every GNOME animation smooth and nonlinear!

Custom curves, interruptible animations, and interruption buffering, all in one extension. Some of GNOME's default animations are linear, counterintuitive, and plain: they never speed up or slow down; when interrupted, they either snap back to the start or re-accelerate from a standstill, and some actions don't support interruption at all.

If you feel the same way, this extension is exactly what you need.
